references.text: Jesus withdraws to a desolate place, something Moses also did to communicate with God.
David also seeks solitude in the wilderness during difficult times, parallel to Jesus' actions.
The importance of finding rest and trust in God, which Jesus demonstrates by withdrawing.
Jesus withdraws to the wilderness to fast and pray, showing the importance of seeking God's presence in solitude.
The similarity with Jesus withdrawing to desolate places to pray underscores the need for spiritual renewal.
